name: tabular_feature_store
title: A feature-store package where the fit lives in one module and the split in another, three files apart
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-tabular: the multi-module shape DATAFLOW-IP exists for

expected.defect: the median imputer is fitted on self.frame, the whole table the job handed the store, and materialise() then splits the result
expected.why: every imputed cell carries a median the held-out rows helped compute; the split is in store/splits.py and the construction in jobs/train_model.py, so nothing in this file looks wrong on its own

expected.defect: the scaler is fitted on the same whole-table block
expected.why: held-out means and variances are inside the training features

expected.defect: the ordinal encoder is fitted on the whole table's categorical columns
expected.why: the 'unknown category' path can never be exercised, because every category the holdout contains was already numbered at fit time

forbidden.why: transform() at line 45 is the inference path and calls transform, never fit; nothing here is fitted on a held-out value
the scoring job only loads a bundle and calls transform on it
splits.py fits nothing at all - it is two split helpers and an import

chronological_split is the temporal answer, and stratified_split is used on a table with no timestamp column; the pd.Timedelta at line 23 is the one temporal signal in the project and one signal is silence by design
SEED reaches train_test_split through stratified_split and the classifier through random_state=SEED at line 30
there is no cross-validation call in this project
the only metric is roc_auc_score, fed a predict_proba column
roc_auc_score is given model.predict_proba(test_x)[:, 1], a score column
the bundle is written with joblib.dump, not torch.save, and there is no torch.load anywhere
